fixes.R1 the re-seed hold is a fixed window (t: at a mount-calibration change (not a new orientation) a track reported in zone gauge (a STOP) stays reported on the change frame and the following frames up to the end of a fixed window, matched or not: a match refreshes the track (position, velocity, confidence, zone and hit history) but no longer ends the window; a missed frame inside it neither decays the confidence nor enters the hit history and reports the track at its predicted position. The window is H frames from the change, the change frame the first (counted from the track's last match before the change when it was already missing at the change, as before: repeated changes do not extend the hold of a track that stays unmatched); H = tracking.reseed_hold (5 processed frames) and, when the change re-seeds the track model (a change above calibration.reseed_keep_max_deg; a new orientation still resets the tracker), at least the frames the re-seeded model has no floor-shadow reference: 1 + ceil(track.axis_warmup_frames / k), k the input rate in periods with track.rates_per_period (6 at 10 Hz, 4 at 5 Hz; so H = 6 at 10 Hz, 5 at 5 Hz). Only tracks reported in zone gauge at the change are held, as now. The config comments (resense/config.py, configs/default.yaml and the ROS copy) and the docs that say 'up to 5 frames after its last match' are corrected to this rule.

ship_rule.gate: exit 0 against regression_baseline_2026-09-25_ride_p3.json with no gated row worse or missing, no --allow
ship_rule.sweep: against 10e2707 in all 52 runs: no STOP frame lost, no frame with a longer nearest distance (> +0.3 m, analyze_fix.py) or a longer clear_distance (> +0.5 m, analyze_fix.py); smaller differences and the frames gained are recorded
ship_rule.stress: no worse than 10e2707: five obstacle-free bags false events / STOP episodes 5 Hz 10 / 10, +3 deg roll 14 / 16, +3 deg pitch 17 / 18 (no count higher); doubleT_obstacle labelled hits @ first alarm frame 92/123 @ 12, 183/246 @ 12, 186/246 @ 11 (no hit count lower, no first alarm later)
ship_rule.tests: T1 and T2 pass; T1 fails on 10e2707; T2 fails with the sign flipped (mutation); ruff check ., pytest on the native and the numpy path (RESENSE_NATIVE=0; 469 before), scripts/sync_params.sh --check and python -m pytest -q web/demo pass
ship_rule.the safety rule decides: a row worse is not traded against a row better; if R1 fails a rule, it is not shipped and the failure is recorded with its cause (R2 and R3 ship on their own)

addendum_3.baseline_rule: if any gated or recorded value of the final clean commit's gate differs from regression_baseline_2026-09-25_ride_p3b.json, that file is re-cut from the final clean commit's run (the name kept) and EXPERIMENTS.md section 1i gets one dated line
